name: domestique
description: Quietly files completed bike-race torrent downloads (autobrr, Transmission, or a manual drop) into a Plex-friendly library layout, renaming them into a standardized "Show - SYYYYEnn - Title - ptNN.ext" scheme. Copies only, never moves or deletes from your download share, so seeding is unaffected. See the project's README for full setup: Transmission's script-torrent-done hook, optional Plex partial-scan refresh, optional hot-folder ingestion, optional Discord notifications, and a password-gated web UI for editing show definitions and testing the matcher. IMPORTANT: on first run, "Config File" below is auto-seeded from the image's own bundled config/events.json (a curated starter list of major/well-known professional races - Grand Tours, Monuments, Worlds, Olympics, top stage races and classics) - open the web UI (set WEBUI_PASSWORD below) or edit that file directly to add the smaller/regional races your own tracker covers, since this list is intentionally not exhaustive.

paths.name: Library Root
paths.description: Your Plex media library root - point this at your actual racing library folder. Renamed/copied files land here.

paths.name: Downloads Share (read-only)
paths.description: The SAME share Transmission's own container maps to /downloads internally - check Transmission's Docker template path mappings to confirm what that is. This is the whole share (not just its 'complete' subfolder), mounted read-only since Domestique only ever copies from here.

paths.name: Hot-folder (read-write, optional)
paths.description: Optional read-write overlay on a 'domestique' subfolder of the share above, for hot-folder ingestion (drop a file/folder here to bypass Transmission entirely). Only takes effect if HOTFOLDER_DIR below is also set to /downloads/domestique; otherwise this is just an unused empty folder.

paths.name: Config File
paths.description: Persists your show/event definitions across container updates and image upgrades. Auto-created from the image's bundled config/events.json the first time this file doesn't exist yet (see the Overview above) - edit it by hand or through the web UI afterward.

paths.name: Settings File
paths.description: Persists your Plex/Discord/hot-folder settings across container updates. Auto-created (seeded from the PLEX_*/DISCORD_*/HOTFOLDER_* variables below) the first time this file doesn't exist yet - edit it live afterward through the web UI's Settings panel instead of these variables. BEFORE FIRST APPLY: from the Unraid terminal, run 'touch /mnt/user/appdata/domestique/settings.json' (or your own path above if changed) - otherwise Docker creates an empty directory there instead of a file, which the app can't clean up on its own.

paths.name: Activity Log
paths.description: Persists the web UI's recent-activity log across container updates and restarts. Auto-created empty the first time this file doesn't exist yet. BEFORE FIRST APPLY: from the Unraid terminal, run 'touch /mnt/user/appdata/domestique/activity.json' (or your own path above if changed) - otherwise Docker creates an empty directory there instead of a file, which the app can't clean up on its own.

ports.name: WebUI / Webhook / Health Port
ports.description: Port the web UI (/ui), the Transmission webhook (/webhook/torrent-done), and the health check (/health) all listen on.

variables.name: LIBRARY_ROOT
variables.description: The container-side path the app uses for the library (must match Library Root's fixed mount point above - you shouldn't need to change this).

variables.name: CONFIG_PATH
variables.description: Where the app looks for the config file above, from inside the container. Matches the Config File mount target - no need to change this.

variables.name: SETTINGS_PATH
variables.description: Where the app looks for the settings file above, from inside the container. Matches the Settings File mount target - no need to change this.

variables.name: ACTIVITY_PATH
variables.description: Where the app looks for the activity log above, from inside the container. Matches the Activity Log mount target - no need to change this.

variables.name: PLEX_URL
variables.description: One-time seed only: used to create Settings File above if it doesn't exist yet, then ignored - edit Plex settings live afterward via the web UI. Enables a Plex partial-scan refresh after each successful archive. e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400

variables.name: PLEX_TOKEN
variables.description: One-time seed only (see PLEX_URL above). Your Plex auth token, required if PLEX_URL is set. See the README's Plex section for how to find it.

variables.name: PLEX_SECTION_ID
variables.description: One-time seed only (see PLEX_URL above). The racing library's Plex section id, required if PLEX_URL is set.

variables.name: PLEX_LIBRARY_ROOT
variables.description: One-time seed only (see PLEX_URL above). Only needed if Plex's own container sees this library at a different internal path than Library Root above (the same category of issue as the Downloads Share mapping).

variables.name: HOTFOLDER_DIR
variables.description: One-time seed only: used to create Settings File above if it doesn't exist yet, then ignored - edit hot-folder settings live afterward via the web UI. Set to /downloads/domestique to enable hot-folder ingestion (matches the read-write mount above). Leave unset to disable.

variables.name: HOTFOLDER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: One-time seed only (see HOTFOLDER_DIR above). Tuning: how often (ms) to check a hot-folder drop for size/mtime stability before processing it.

variables.name: HOTFOLDER_STABLE_POLLS
variables.description: One-time seed only (see HOTFOLDER_DIR above). Tuning: consecutive stable polls required before a hot-folder drop is treated as done.

variables.name: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
variables.description: One-time seed only: used to create Settings File above if it doesn't exist yet, then ignored - edit Discord settings live afterward via the web UI. Posts a summary message to a Discord channel after every torrent-done event. Create one via the target channel's Settings, Integrations, Webhooks.

variables.name: DISCORD_MENTION_USER_ID
variables.description: One-time seed only (see DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL above). A Discord user id to @mention, but only on review-worthy notifications (auto-created shows, warnings, errors). Leave unset to have every notification post without a mention.

variables.name: WEBUI_PASSWORD
variables.description: Set this to enable the web UI at /ui (events editor, match tester, upload, activity log). Fails CLOSED, not open: leaving this unset keeps /ui and /api/* returning 503, since that surface can read and overwrite your config.

variables.name: WEBUI_USER
variables.description: Optional: also require this exact username (HTTP Basic Auth) alongside WEBUI_PASSWORD. Leave unset to accept any username, checking only the password.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Run the app as this user id instead of root (99 = Unraid's 'nobody', the same user most containers including Transmission run as). The container fixes ownership of its two config files automatically; the Library Root (and hot-folder, if used) must be writable by this user - on a default Unraid share that's already true, otherwise run once from the terminal: chown -R 99:100 on those paths. Blank = run as root.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group id to run as (100 = Unraid's 'users' group, paired with PUID 99 above). Blank = run as root.
